messages:
maria: heads up — thinking about a small improvement to the deploy bot: conditional rollouts + a simple templated preflight. want something we can reuse across services and avoid manual rollback finger-pointing. ideas?
kevin: +1. can we add a --guard flag that wires a health-check + error-threshold for auto-rollback? keeps manual steps minimal. :thumbsup:
ashley: love the guard idea. also propose a preflight template that runs lint, smoke test, and verifies config pinning. short snippet: `preflight: [lint, smoke, pin-check]`
ian: if we do auto-rollback we need a safe default: 5% canary, 30s stabilization, 3x failures -> rollback. annotate in change window.
deploy-bot: deploy started: service=auth v=2026.03.12-rc3 mode=canary pct=5 change_window=utc02-06 initiator=@maria
kevin: small UX idea — `deploy --canary 5 --guard 0.03 --stabilize 30s` where guard is the error-rate threshold (3%). create flags for `--pin` (model/version) and `--notes-template`
ashley: here's a quick preflight template we can add to repo (one-liner style):
```
# .deploy/preflight.yaml
steps:
  - lint: npm run lint
  - smoke: curl -fsS http://canary.example/health
  - pin-check: grep -q "pin: true" deploy_metadata.yaml
```
ian: + also add `rollback-on-cascade: true` option so if dependent services fail we cascade rollback. needs careful defaults.
sam: for release notes we should auto-generate a changelog stub: `deploy --notes-template=basic` -> creates `RELEASE_NOTES.md` with sections: Summary, Risk, RollbackPlan, RolloutPlan. makes handoffs easier for oncall.
maria: perfect. can we prototype a helper script that wraps `deploy` and runs preflight, then calls deploy-bot with flags? keep it small and bash-y so teams can fork.
ian: put it under infra/scripts/deploy_wrapper.sh. pseudocode: 
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
./ci/preflight.sh || { echo "preflight failed"; exit 1; }
deployctl --service "$1" --version "$2" --canary ${CANARY:-5} --guard ${GUARD:-0.03} --notes-template ${NOTES:-basic}
```
kevin: we should also have `deploy-bot` emit an ephemeral link to the generated release notes and a quick button to `abort`/`force-complete` in the thread.
ashley: add docs: `docs/release/guarded-rollouts.md` with examples and recommended thresholds by service (low-latency vs batch).
maria: ok action items: 1) kevin/ian prototype guard flag + bot UI button, 2) ashley write preflight template & docs, 3) ian add wrapper script and default thresholds, 4) sam wire notes-template to CI. i'll open a tracking PR and link it here.
deploy-bot: noted. created task: https://git.internal/r/REDWOOD/infra/+/4567 — please comment with PR numbers.
kevin: i'll take the bot side. starting with `--guard` impl and button state. ETA end of week.
ashley: i'll draft preflight + docs today and add examples for `auth` and `search`.
ian: wrapper script + CI step monday. will seed sensible defaults.
maria: thanks all. if we can keep the initial rollout conservative, we can iterate on thresholds after a few real deploys. :rocket:
